description: 2-bedroom apartment on a quiet Limited Traffic Zone street steps from Pont Neuf, the Seine and the Louvre. This spacious two-floor apartment comfortably sleeps 6 guests. Fully equipped kitchen, hotel-quality beds and full A/C throughout. Perfect for families, groups or couples seeking an elegant home in the heart of historic Paris.The spaceThe duplex apartment combines modern comfort with authentic 17th-century character . The spacious and excellent layout works particularly well for families or groups. The apartment is bright, quiet and well maintained. Set in the heart of central Paris, it provides an excellent base for exploring the city. A plasma TV with Apple TV is available for evenings in. The original beamed drawing room, filled with natural light, features 2 large comfortable sofas and a dining area perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Solid oak parquet floors and double-glazed windows ensure your stay will be both a comfortable and peaceful one.Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements:• 2 bright, quiet bedrooms, 5-star hotel standard beds. The main bedroom is a fully private galleried space, designed to maximise light and a sense of space.Bedroom 1: 1 Queen + 1 SingleBedroom 2: 1 Single (with option to move the extra single from Bedroom 1 if required)Salon: High-quality double sofa bed designed for everyday use, offering the comfort of a real bed with no need to remove cushions.Kitchen & Bathrooms:Fully-equipped separate modern kitchen, with dishwasher, washer/dryer.
